questions.subject: English
questions.question_en:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error:
'One of the students (A)/ have submitted (B)/ their project report (C)/ before the deadline. (D)/ No Error (E)'
questions.question_hi:
वाक्य के उस खंड की पहचान करें जिसमें व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है:
'One of the students (A)/ have submitted (B)/ their project report (C)/ before the deadline. (D)/ No Error (E)'
questions.explanation_en: The error is in segment B. 'One of the students' is singular, so it should be 'has submitted' instead of 'have submitted'. The correct sentence: 'One of the students has submitted their project report before the deadline.'
questions.explanation_hi: त्रुटि खंड B में है। 'One of the students' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'have submitted' के बजाय 'has submitted' होना चाहिए। सही वाक्य: 'One of the students has submitted their project report before the deadline.'
questions.reference: Objective General English by S.P. Bakshi
